name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-laya
description: Safe-by-default MCP for Laya: fast, local, typed decisions (classify/score/yes-no), 100+ langs.

environmentVariables.name: LAYA_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Checkpoint to use: auto (Router picks) | english | multilingual | typed-decisions.

environmentVariables.name: LAYA_MODELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of checkpoints that may load. Empty = all.

environmentVariables.name: LAYA_ALLOW_DOWNLOAD
environmentVariables.description: Allow the one-time Hugging Face checkpoint download. Off by default (offline).

environmentVariables.name: LAYA_MIN_CONFIDENCE
environmentVariables.description: Flag answers below this calibrated confidence (0 = never flag).
